verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents a dedicated, native PostgreSQL database that you connect to directly, and names psql, Prisma and Drizzle as supported clients, with pooling, replicas and PITR. That covers standard clients and ORMs. Older 2022 community comments saying Postgres was 'not yet supported' predate this offering, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the connection-string format or credentials flow, and independent or hands-on confirmation of direct ORM connections; direct access also appears limited to the dedicated PostgreSQL engine rather than the managed TablesDB API.
